title: Where Should a Marketplace Spend Its Delivery Improvement Budget?
grain: One order with exactly one recorded item from one seller; incomplete outcomes are retained
question: Should a marketplace direct an equal number of review slots to seller handoffs or to post-handoff delivery?
design: Separate final lateness by whether handoff met the seller timestamp. Adjust for destination and within-state delivery, shrink seller rates, and freeze priorities before each future quarter. Use only outcomes known at that decision date. Compare identical numbers of review slots, with explicit cost and effectiveness break-even.
boundary: An on-time handoff followed by a late delivery locates delay in the observed sequence. It does not establish fault or show that an intervention prevented lateness.
